protocol.purpose: Test whether one verified failure/success action pair selected through a fixed forcing-prior teacher search produces persistent all-legal choice improvement beyond matched controls, while preserving v1 as the neural-only search comparison.
protocol.scope: Separate follow-up acquisition screen using the same inspected development positions and controls as v1; only forcingPriorMix changes from 0 to 0.5. Not a statistical acquisition result, unfamiliar transfer, or reasoning proof.

teacherAnchors.selection: After the search commits, pair the selected verified outcome with one independently verified opposite-outcome action. If the selected consequence is unknown, do not teach it; use the two independently verified anchors instead.
